| [Hot, excluded and cold tumor patterns](/wiki/education/concepts/immunology/tumor-immunology/hot-excluded-cold-tumor) | Three matching fictional tumor-tissue fields show eight specified T-cell symbols in both inflamed and excluded patterns, relocated from mainly inside cancer-cell regions to surrounding stroma; a desert field has two. Symbol count is distinct from a stromal-area score. | `matched-tissue-fields-v2-light.svg` | Present | Not found |

| [Immune escape](/wiki/education/concepts/immunology/tumor-immunology/immune-escape) | Three stacked panels compare baseline surface HLA-I in control and JAK2-deficient fictional cultures, an increase only in control after matched IFNγ exposure, and unanswered T-cell recognition, tissue-access and killing-test questions. | `immune-escape-baseline-induction-v1-light.png` | Present | Present |

| [In-situ vaccination](/wiki/education/concepts/immunology/tumor-immunology/in-situ-vaccination) | Conditional tumor material collection, lymph-node priming and access to an uninjected lesion; local and distant outcomes are independent measurements. | `tumor-material-presenting-cells-and-distant-lesion-v1-light.svg` | Present | Present |

| [Tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes](/wiki/education/concepts/immunology/tumor-immunology/tumor-infiltrating-lymphocytes) | A fictional ten-by-ten array contains 100 counted lymphocytes, of which 30 blue circles are CD8 T cells and 70 purple circles are other lymphocytes. The 30% counted-cell fraction differs from the stromal-area percentage in the reused diagram. | `counted-lymphocyte-denominator-v1-light.svg` | Present | Present |

| [Tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes](/wiki/education/concepts/immunology/tumor-immunology/tumor-infiltrating-lymphocytes) | A fictional tissue schematic excludes malignant nests from eligible stroma, then pools five equal stromal-area units containing one occupied unit to show 20 percent stromal-area infiltration. This is an area estimate, not a cell count. | `stromal-area-and-pooled-region-weighting-v1-light.svg` | Present | Present |

| [Stromal TIL scoring: what the percentage counts](/wiki/education/concepts/measurement/pathology-readouts/stil-scoring) | A schematic pretend pretreatment section distinguishes excluded malignant nests and eligible stroma inside invasive-tumor borders. Separate invented area blocks show region A with four equal units of eligible stroma and 0.4 units occupied by infiltrate, and B with one equal unit of stroma and 0.6 occupied units. At the same scale, the pooled-area fraction is 1/5, or 20%; the unweighted regional mean is 35%. Area, not cell count, is the denominator. This toy geometry is not a mandated pixel workflow; pretreatment and residual-bed methods remain distinct. | `stromal-area-and-pooled-region-weighting-v1-light.svg` | Present | Present |
